Your approved schedule remains unchanged: KEEP_A, KEEP_B, and CAP_AM.

• CAP_AM meets Monday and Wednesday, 8:00–9:15 a.m.; your schedule totals 12 credits.
• CAP_ALT meets Tuesday and Thursday, 8:00–9:15 a.m.; the alternative would also total 12 credits.

Both satisfy your required CAP4000 course, your completed CS3000 prerequisite, and your 12–16 credit requirement. CAP_ALT has one available seat and conflicts with neither your other classes nor your Tuesday/Thursday work hours of noon–5:00 p.m. Both sections are morning classes, so neither meets your afternoon preference.
